scope: City and satellite card-to-dedicated-review image records only; not full visual acceptance or runtime
findings: 156/156 current city/satellite cards have a dedicated review PNG record; all source hashes match. 68 distinct PNG paths are legitimately shared by characters on multi-person boards, not duplicate cards.

Older manifest schemas omit CHAR tags or use aliases: ALD-S02-NPC-Fenko, ALD-NPC-SORE, EED-NPC-SUJIN/GELI, CHAR-MAYA and CHAR-赫斯·白. Old batches also use root manifest/README/prompts rather than per-batch manifest. Absence of a normalized CHAR tag alone is not a missing PNG.
MAE-NPC-KAEM is explicitly the same N10 Kaem on the current card; reuse of the batch09 cast image does not create a second actor.
This audit checks coverage records and files, not every older board pixel or all historic manifest semantics. Previously unviewed boards remain unviewed for independent visual QA.
